description: This file contains serialization utility functions for string conversions, encoding (hex, base64), UTF-16/CodePoint conversions, and string escaping, used for data serialization/deserialization within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

methods.name: ToString (const wchar_t[], std::string&)
methods.description: Converts a wide-character string to a standard string using wcstombs on supported platforms.

methods.name: ToString (const char[], std::wstring&)
methods.description: Converts a char array to wide string using mbstowcs.

methods.name: ToString (const wchar_t[], unsigned int)
methods.description: Converts a wchar_t array to a std::string, considering Unicode or non-Unicode builds.

methods.name: ToString (const char[], unsigned int)
methods.description: Converts a char array to std::string, with Unicode considerations.

methods.name: void EXTERNAL ToHexString(const uint8_t object[],const uint16_t length,string & result)
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: uint16_t EXTERNAL FromHexString(const string & hexString,uint8_t * object,const uint16_t maxLength)
methods.description: Decodes a hexadecimal string into a byte array.

methods.name: ToString (base64 encoding)
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a Base64 string with optional padding.

methods.name: FromString (base64 decoding)
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into a byte array, updating length.

methods.name: bool CodePointToUTF16(const uint32_t codePoint,uint16_t & lowPart,uint16_t & highPart)
methods.description: Converts a code point to UTF-16 surrogate pairs if needed.

methods.name: bool UTF16ToCodePoint(const uint16_t lowPart,const uint16_t highPart,uint32_t & codePoint)
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 surrogate pairs to a code point.

methods.name: int8_t ToCodePoint(const TCHAR * data,const uint8_t length,uint32_t & codePoint)
methods.description: Decodes a UTF-8 encoded sequence to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: int8_t FromCodePoint(uint32_t codePoint,TCHAR * data,const uint8_t length)
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into UTF-8 sequence.

methods.name: string EXTERNAL ToQuotedString(const TCHAR quote,const string & input)
methods.description: Returns a string with internal quotes escaped, wrapped in quotes.

string ToString(const char realString[],unsigned int length)

void ToString(const uint8_t object[],const uint16_t length,const bool padding,string & result)
